viewer.title: Building 3D view — CityGML Attribute Editor
viewer.rot_left_title: Rotate counterclockwise (hold to keep rotating; orbits around the screen center)
viewer.rot_right_title: Rotate clockwise (hold to keep rotating; orbits around the screen center)
viewer.no_lod2_title: This building has no LOD2 (detailed shape)
editor.title: CityGML Attribute Editor
editor.hint_pick_mesh: Select a blue square on the map in the top left
editor.pane3d_empty: Select a building to see it in 3D
editor.cards_empty: 1. Click a blue square on the map in the top left → 2. Click one of the light-blue buildings that appear
editor.guide_lead: First, pick one building to edit on the map.
editor.guide_step1: Click a blue square on the map in the top left.
editor.guide_step2: Wait until the buildings finish loading.
editor.guide_step3: Click one of the light-blue buildings shown inside the square.
editor.guide_step4: Attributes appear on the right. Click an editable value to change it.
editor.guide_note: Changing a value does not send anything by itself. When you change a value, a source selector opens right below it. Only after you choose a source and press "Send changes" is your proposal delivered to the maintainer.
editor.modal_sub: The source data is not modified directly; a readable summary for the maintainer is generated from the selected sources and the before/after values.
editor.reason_placeholder: e.g. survey date, URLs of documents you checked, anything the maintainer should know
editor.pretest_note_initial: Before sending, your changes are checked on this computer.
editor.btn_done_close: Close and return to the attribute editor
editor.confirm_discard_move: You have edits in progress. Discard them and move on? (PRs are per building)
editor.hint_pick_source: Next: choose a source under each changed value ({n} left)
editor.hint_send: Next: press "Send changes" at the bottom right ({n} changes)
editor.hint_click_value: Next: click a value on the right that you want to change
editor.hint_pick_building: Next: click one light-blue building on the map (tile {code})
editor.src_appended: + {list} (to be added along with the item notes)
editor.source_done_label: ✓ Source you checked for this change
editor.source_required_label: Next, choose the source you checked for this change (required)
editor.src_add_title: Inherits the default ({src}). Click to add an item-specific source
editor.src_delete_unsupported: Removing an existing item-specific source is not supported yet (you can revert pre-PR changes with "Discard changes")
editor.err_no_angle_brackets: The characters < and > cannot be used in values
editor.btn_pr_needs_sources: You can send once a source is chosen for every changed attribute
editor.alert_pick_all_sources: Choose a source for every changed attribute
editor.pretest_note_rerun: Because the description changed, the pre-submission check runs again.
editor.pretest_pass: ✅ Passed the pre-submission check. You can send this.
editor.pretest_fail: ❌ Some items need attention. Please fix the items shown in red.
editor.sending: Sending your changes. Please keep the browser open…
editor.sent_wait_review: Awaiting review by the maintainer. You can close this screen.
editor.sent_needs_confirm: ⚠ Your change data reached GitHub. Only the final send confirmation is needed.
editor.sent_github_steps: On the page that opens, press the green "Create pull request" button, then press the same button again on the confirmation screen.
editor.err_change_ident: The changed attribute could not be identified. Please reload the page
editor.err_source_target_ident: The attribute for this source could not be identified. Please reload the page
editor.err_source_duplicate: Multiple sources are specified for the same attribute
editor.err_source_not_in_list: The selected source is not in the code list. Please reload the page
editor.err_source_unknown_code: "Unknown" or "Not created" cannot be chosen as the source of a changed attribute
editor.err_source_missing: Choose a source for the changed attributes: {list}
editor.err_leaf_not_found: {tag}[{idx}] was not found (the file may have been modified)
editor.err_leaf_mismatch: The current value of {tag}[{idx}] does not match (expected: {old}). Please reload the page
editor.err_postedit_xml: XML verification after editing failed (apply aborted): {exc}
editor.check_reason_pass: Your reason is what reviewers read as the reason for the change
editor.check_reason_fail: Write why you changed the value and what you checked (at least 5 characters)
editor.check_changes_fail: There are no items to change
editor.check_building_missing: The target building data was not found
editor.check_source_pass: A document you checked is selected for every changed attribute
editor.check_building_pass: Only the single building with building ID {id} is targeted
editor.check_xml_pass: The file still parses correctly as XML after the change
editor.check_xml_fail: The changed XML cannot be parsed: {exc}
editor.check_scope_pass: Only the target building's file will be sent
editor.check_scope_fail: Other building data also has unorganized changes
editor.check_srcsync_pass: The item-specific source note and the building-level source code are updated together
editor.check_srcsync_na: No source note needs to be added this time
editor.pretest_server_note: Detailed schema checks and more run again in the automated checks after you send
editor.err_src_qname: The attribute name for the source note is invalid: {qname}
editor.err_src_mismatch: The current value of the source note ({qname}) does not match (expected: {old}). Please reload the page
editor.err_src_not_found: The source note ({qname}) was not found (the file may have been modified)
editor.err_src_no_creation: Adding a source note to a building without creationDate is not supported
editor.err_pr_auto_failed: Could not automatically create the change proposal for the maintainer ({message}).
editor.err_pretest_not_passed: The pre-submission check has not passed: {list}
editor.err_udx_dirty:
There are changes to files other than the target under udx/. Please clean them up first:
{list}
editor.err_upstream_advanced: This building's file has been updated in the city repository. Please reload the page and redo the edit on the latest data.
editor.err_not_editable: {label} cannot be edited. Please reload the page
editor.err_source_conflict: The source specified for "{label}" does not match
editor.err_no_identity: This copy of the city has no author set for the account, so nothing was sent. Open the hub and choose the account again (Settings → GitHub account).
editor.err_push_failed:
Could not send to GitHub. Your edits remain on this screen. Check your internet connection and try again.
{stderr}
editor.err_no_bldg_data: udx/bldg was not found in {root} (check the --data option)
pr.source_added: Because the selected source was not in this building's source list, source code(s) {codes} were also added.
pr.cc0_footer: The data changes in this PR are provided under the [Data Contribution Policy]({url}) (CC0 1.0).
editor.preview_unavailable: The description will be generated when you send.
editor.pr_lang_note: This proposal will be written in {lang} — the working language of {city}'s reviewers. Your screen language is not affected.
label.name: Name
editor.err_org_restricted: The organization that hosts this city has not approved this tool yet. Ask an organization owner to grant it access (GitHub → Settings → Applications → this app → Organization access). Your upload is kept; the proposal can be opened later.
editor.err_push_no_account: No GitHub account is connected for this city, so nothing can be sent. Your edits remain on this screen. Open the hub, choose the account (Settings → GitHub account), then press Send again.
editor.confirm_loading: Collecting what this send will do…
editor.confirm_identity_unset: (not set — choose the account in the hub first)
editor.confirm_pr_manual: GitHub opens for the final step (one green button)
editor.confirm_lead: This is what will happen when you press "Send as shown":
editor.confirm_blocked: Nothing can be sent yet. Open the hub, choose the GitHub account for this city (Settings → GitHub account), then come back and press "Review before sending" again.
editor.confirm_origin_bad: Nothing can be sent yet: the upload target of this data folder is not your copy under this account. Open the hub and choose the account again (Settings → Change); the hub sets the upload target.
editor.check_source_none: This city's data records no source per attribute; your reason is the record
